steps.content:
**I'd buy from Ottervale Audio (seller B), but only by a small margin.** The two listings are almost identical.

| | Brackmoor Sound (A) | Ottervale Audio (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

**Why B:** Ottervale says it is an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" and that the headphones come with the "Full manufacturer warranty." Brackmoor says neither. An authorized dealer is more likely to sell genuine, new stock. It also makes a warranty claim with Quellwyn easier. If Brackmoor isn't authorized, the manufacturer might not honor the warranty.

**Caveats:**
- The authorized-dealer claim comes from the listing itself. I haven't verified it. Check Quellwyn's website for a list of authorized retailers if that matters to you.
- Both listings show the same rating and review count, 4.3 from 210 reviews. That may mean the reviews are for the product in general and not for each seller, so they don't tell you much about either seller.
- Brackmoor's listing doesn't say it is unauthorized. It just doesn't say. If Brackmoor had a lower price, it might be worth the risk, but the prices are the same.
